scope: Clean 15 static demo pet portraits and full-screen Heart Moment regression
verification_method: Python Playwright Chromium with local scripts/assets inlined to bypass browser filesystem/network admin restrictions; Node JS syntax and Netlify build command

results.demo_portraits: 15/15 image files present; JPEG 600x1000; clean backgrounds (no baked labels or artificial blurred top/bottom)
results.demo_scores: 15/15 score labels match demo pet selection
results.heartbeat_view: 15/15 phone 390x844 Heart Moment images loaded, computed filter=none, object-fit=cover, overlay visible
results.home_to_heart: 15/15 clicked original Heart Moments button and entered directly
results.png_download: 1/1 representative Chrome download produced playable PNG (Milo)
results.desktop: 1440x900 viewport produced centered phone-size 430px Heart Moment; no blur
results.js_syntax: all active JavaScript files node --check pass
results.build: node build.mjs produced dist/ with 15 demo portraits; cleaned dist before ZIP to avoid duplicate deploy roots
results.zip: ZIP integrity and SHA-256 manifest verified

constraints: 15 portraits are demonstration images and not guaranteed identities of previously named pets; breed and appearance may differ for swapped examples
This does not confirm AI image generation of four genuine expressions for arbitrary new user-uploaded pet photos: requires configured Netlify function and remote model service
Demo scores, heart-rate, respiration and HRV readings are simulated; not real collar data or veterinary assessments
Public Netlify and iOS Safari have not been tested; existing legacy pages were not all re-tested end to end
The preview photo montage places test-only labels outside separate JPEG photos; JPEGs contain no baked-in text
